reason: Automatically enriches custom-provider model configurations with catalog metadata, optionally refreshes external sources, discovers gateway models, and presents controls for applying updates without overwriting existing values.

summaries.zh: 为自定义供应商模型从配置的数据目录补填上下文长度、输出上限、显示名和输入模态等元数据，并提供刷新、发现与应用管理界面。
summaries.en: Fills missing context, output-limit, display-name, and input-modality metadata for custom-provider models from configured catalogs, with controls for refreshing, discovering, and applying updates.

capabilities: Fetches model metadata from configured HTTP sources
Optionally fetches model lists from configured provider gateway endpoints
Writes missing model metadata into the host settings pipeline
Exposes local HTTP endpoints for status, lookup, refresh, application, and model discovery
Provides a host service and web interface for model metadata management
